Summary: Counterparty matching service: confirmed same-entity and documented-affiliation outcomes for named counterparties (prerequisite to CAPITAL_EVENT_INVOLVES)
Description: 1) Original intent: the decision record (decision-record-structural-analysis-FINAL-20261011.md, sections 3 and 6) requires that a capital-event relationship is admitted only when each counterparty has a confirmed matching outcome (same entity confirmed, affiliation confirmed, transaction link confirmed); candidate matches and unresolved names are not admitted and the evidence standard is not lowered. The 8-K extractor (KRYL-1399) returns names exactly as written in the filing with no identifier, so no counterparty can be admitted today. This ticket supplies the matching outcome. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) for each extracted counterparty name the service returns one outcome from {SAME_ENTITY_CONFIRMED, AFFILIATION_CONFIRMED, CANDIDATE_MATCH, UNRESOLVED} with the identifier (SEC CIK), the canonical registered name, and the evidence (source, accession, form, filing date, retrieval time, rule applied); (b) SAME_ENTITY_CONFIRMED only when the name, with legal suffixes normalized, equals exactly one SEC registrant name (the same rule KRYL-1380 uses to admit filers); two registrants carrying the same name is UNRESOLVED (ambiguous); (c) AFFILIATION_CONFIRMED only when the filing's own text documents the relationship next to the name ('a wholly owned subsidiary of X', 'an affiliate of X') and X itself is a SAME_ENTITY_CONFIRMED registrant; (d) a name with only a similar registrant is CANDIDATE_MATCH and is never admitted; (e) a failed or rate-limited lookup is a lookup failure (absence class b), never a negative match; (f) the filer itself and its subsidiaries are not counterparties; (g) tests run on real SEC search responses saved as fixtures (confirmed and unconfirmed names, an ambiguous name), plus failure and rate-limit cases; (h) the service does not admit anything and writes no relationship. 3) Current implementation state: not built. Name-to-CIK exact matching exists only inside verifyPublicFiler (secfileradmission.js) for public filers with annual reports. A read-only probe on 2026-10-11 showed SEC name search confirms some counterparty names (for example a listed issuer, a bank holding company, a bank subsidiary) and returns nothing or two registrants for others (a broker-dealer subsidiary; one name carried by two CIKs), so unresolved is an expected, correct outcome. 4) Dependencies: edgar8kcontent.js (counterparty names, roles, passages); engine /api/edgar proxy and its request spacing; secfileradmission.js normalization rules (reuse, no second copy of the name rules); KRYL-1399. Blocks the CAPITAL_EVENT_INVOLVES admission ticket. Shared-data gate (CLAUDE.md section 2) applies to any shared name-normalization helper. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes (admitted, evidence-grounded relationships; Absence-Is-Signal; decision record step 3 prerequisite). Status: opened 2026-10-11 on the Founder's instruction to proceed to Step 3.
